mechanisms.target_behavior: Continue with a focused recovery instead of ending after an isolated tool error when ample budget remains.
mechanisms.precondition: n_errors >= 1 and err_streak == 0 and step_frac < 0.5 and steps_left > 2
mechanisms.text: A prior tool observation contained an error, but there is still substantial budget. Use its details to make a focused recovery attempt and continue toward the requested outcome before deciding whether the task is complete.
